title: Arguments and Variable Blocks
scenario: Arguments are key/value pairs inside a block. Declare the app_name input variable with a description, a string type and a default.

focus.title: Complete the variable block
focus.todo: Add the description, type and default arguments.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `variables.tf`. The work is inside `variable "app_name"`. Add the description, type and default arguments. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `variables.tf` and work only inside `variable "app_name"`. Use this code shape: description; type; default. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.

test_manifest.title: app_name is declared with type and default
